# Rollbar

Error tracking and monitoring platform for developers

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/rollbar/.

## Actions

- **Check Team Project Assignment** (read-only): Check if a team is assigned to a project in Rollbar.
- **Check User Team Assignment** (read-only): Check if a user is assigned to a team in Rollbar.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific Rollbar project by its ID.
- **Get Team by ID** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific team by ID.
- **Get User by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific user from Rollbar by their user ID.
- **List All Projects** (read-only): List all projects in the Rollbar account.
- **List All Teams** (read-only): List all teams in a Rollbar account.
- **List All Users** (read-only): List all users in the Rollbar account.
- **List Project Teams** (read-only): List all teams with access to a Rollbar project.
- **List Team Projects** (read-only): List all projects a team has access to in Rollbar.
- **List User Teams** (read-only): List all teams a user belongs to in Rollbar.
- **Get Occurrences Metrics** (read-only): Get occurrence counts over a span of time with flexible grouping, filtering, and aggregation.
- **Get TTR metrics** (read-only): Get resolution time metrics for a list of projects.
- **List RQL Jobs** (read-only): List all RQL (Rollbar Query Language) jobs.
- **List Team Invitations** (read-only): List pending invitations to a Rollbar team.
- **List Team Users** (read-only): List all users in a Rollbar team.
- **List User Projects** (read-only): List all projects a user has access to.
